newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Fuel awarded Egypt contract.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Fuel awarded Egypt contract.

text.p: Electronic Fuel Control Inc said Wednesday it was awarded an exclusive contract for the initial conversion of 200 commercial vehicles in Egypt to clean air fuel that reduces operating costs up to 50 percent.
The contract includes an intial pilot program order for the 200 vehicles with Ahlia Trading & Commercial of Cairo, an Electronic Fuel distributor.
Electronic Fuel makes and sells systems for the conversion of gas and diesel engines to non-petroluem fuels.
